Ortho 24
La Grange

A generous Ardennes retreat, where stone walls meet contemporary comfort. Gather with family or friends, settle into slow mornings and make the most of the pool and outdoor hot tub.

ORTHO · ARDENNES

Ortho 25
Le Cottage

8 guests3 bedrooms3 bathrooms

A welcoming stone cottage in the village of Ortho. With a private garden and space for eight, it is a lovely base for forest walks, unhurried lunches and time together in the Ardennes.
